q: QPR were founder members of the Premier League. Where did they finish in the inaugural 1992-93 season?
hint: They were the highest-placed London club that season, finishing above both Tottenham and Arsenal.

q: The nickname 'the Hoops' comes from the club's shirt. Which two colours are the hoops?
hint: Celtic wear the green version of the same design; the Loftus Road version swaps in a cooler colour.

q: In May 2011 an FA commission fined QPR £875,000 over the registration of one of their midfielders, but imposed no points deduction, so the promotion stood. Which midfielder was at the centre of the case?
hint: The Argentine had joined from Instituto in 2009, and the charges that were dismissed concerned third-party ownership rules.

q: Who scored the 90th-minute goal that won QPR the 2014 Championship play-off final at Wembley?
hint: The veteran striker struck from the edge of the box with almost the last kick of the game against Derby County.

q: Which manager led QPR to the Championship title and promotion to the Premier League in 2010-11?
hint: He arrived from Crystal Palace in March 2010, and was sacked in January 2012 during the club's first season back in the top flight.

q: QPR led 2-1 at Manchester City on the final day of 2011-12 before the hosts turned it around in stoppage time. Who scored the goal that had put Rangers in front?
hint: The Scotland forward headed in Armand Traoré's cross just after the hour, with Rangers already down to ten men.

q: QPR lost the 2003 Division Two play-off final at the Millennium Stadium to an extra-time goal. Which club beat them?
hint: Andy Campbell's chip over Chris Day settled it, taking the winners into the second tier for the first time since 1985.

q: QPR were relegated to the third tier at the end of 2000-01, their first drop that low since the 1960s. Which former Rangers midfielder had taken over as manager that February?
hint: He had played for the club in the 1990s before returning to the dugout, and later took them back up as Division Two runners-up in 2004.

q: QPR won the 2014 Championship play-off final at Wembley. Which club did they beat?
hint: The beaten side dominated possession and were managed by Steve McClaren, who called it the cruellest game ever.

q: Which manager was in charge when QPR were relegated from the Premier League at the end of 1995-96?
hint: The former England midfielder had replaced Gerry Francis in late 1994 and left Loftus Road in September 1996.

q: QPR signed Trevor Sinclair in 1993 for a fee that broke his previous club's record for a sale. Which club did he leave?
hint: The £600,000 move took the winger from the Lancashire coast to west London; he went on to join West Ham in 1998.

q: Trevor Sinclair's overhead kick for QPR won the BBC's Goal of the Season in 1997. Which club were the opponents in that FA Cup fourth-round tie?
hint: Rangers won the January tie 3-2 at Loftus Road, and the opponents went up to the Premier League that same season.

q: Which striker scored 24 Premier League goals for QPR in the 1994-95 season?
hint: 'Sir Les' came through non-league football at Hayes before making his name at Loftus Road.

q: QPR sold Les Ferdinand for £6m in the summer of 1995. Which club bought him?
hint: Kevin Keegan's side paid the fee; Ferdinand only moved on to Tottenham two years later.

q: QPR won automatic promotion from Division Two in 2003-04 as runners-up. Which club finished above them as champions?
hint: The Devon club took the title on 90 points, with Bristol City finishing third, a single point behind QPR.

q: QPR played much of the 2014 Championship play-off final with ten men. Which midfielder was sent off in the 60th minute?
hint: He was dismissed for hauling down Johnny Russell as the Derby forward ran through on goal.

q: What is the name of QPR's home ground in Shepherd's Bush, where the club has played since 1917?
hint: The ground sits off South Africa Road, holds around 18,000, and Fulham groundshared there in the early 2000s.

q: Harry Redknapp took over as QPR manager in November 2012. Which manager did he replace?
hint: His predecessor had taken just four points from the opening twelve league games of that season.

q: QPR broke their transfer record in January 2013 to sign a defender from Anzhi Makhachkala. Who was he?
hint: The £12.5m fee could not save Rangers, who finished bottom of the table on 25 points that season.

q: Which attacking midfielder was named Championship Player of the Year after scoring 19 league goals in QPR's 2010-11 promotion season?
hint: The Morocco international had signed permanently from Tottenham the previous August.
